role_note: His885, JAK1. Directed towards solvent, which leaves the P-loop sitting about 2 A higher than JAK2's and opens the small lipophilic groove the trifluoromethyl group uses. The authors call this explanation speculative
Glu930, JAK1 hinge. Its main-chain carbonyl accepts from a pyrazole nitrogen
Leu932, JAK1 hinge. Its main-chain amide donates to the other pyrazole nitrogen
Asn859, JAK2. Bent towards the binding pocket and hydrogen bonding Glu1015, which the authors suggest closes the pocket against this compound
Phe860, JAK2. May orient the phenyl ring into a closed disposition, akin to a DFG pocket. Speculative
Glu930, JAK2 hinge. Same contact as in JAK1, and the same residue number by coincidence rather than by alignment
Glu1015, JAK2. Hydrogen bonds Asn859 in the interaction the authors propose closes the pocket
